newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market sees prices largely unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market sees prices largely unchanged.

text.p: Tops prices were unchanged on Monday with the exception of English 58s and 56s which fell one pence per kg, trade sources said.
With little dramatic movement in sterling against the mark and resistance pegged at around 2.49, the market remained fairly calm.

The marginal easing in values for English types was generally taken as a sign that the price rise for raw-state topmaking wools at the last UK auction would not be maintained at the next sale on 13th November.
But some sources are growing nervous about the tame level of trade as the Christmas recess nears.
"Although producers are reluctant to accept bid below costs, this kind of business is still being done," one source said.
